description: This Java class implements a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel for rendering cached sub-content within the OFBiz framework. It manages content retrieval, rendering, and editing link generation for content objects in a web application.

classes.name: RenderSubContentCacheTransform
classes.description: A Freemarker transform class for rendering sub-content with caching in OFBiz.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Creates a custom Writer that renders sub-content, manages context, and generates edit links.

methods.name: renderSubContent
methods.description: Handles the actual rendering of the content or edit link within the transform.

methods.name: openEditWrap
methods.description: Outputs the opening HTML for an editable content block.

methods.name: closeEditWrap
methods.description: Outputs the closing HTML and edit link for an editable content block.

methods.name: getEditStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the CSS style class for the edit wrapper.
